subject: th-cont
title: TH.CONT.------AF.COMP.
description: First of two diagrams in PR.S(RD)II-19. The following prose names the structural target: 'The progressional move to apply transfer redefinitions on creative black music can be viewed in the early solidification of the music. In that period, western journalism would focus on the specifics of a given performer as a means to dissect the reality of the composite music. But the nature of how this focus was applied would establish from the beginning a profound insensitivity to the actual music.' The crossing diagrams how thrust-continuance structurally meets affinity-compression at the journalism-dissection-of-composite-music scale: TH-CONT (thrust continuance) crossed with AF-COMP (affinity compression). TH-CONT sits at upper-left with the subject-arrow; AF-COMP at the bottom-right as partner-axis. SG (source initiation) branches up to the right from the main line and carries COS-P (cosmic-particulars), which carries (R)PROJ-DY (the reality of projectional dynamics). PRI-INFO (principle information) branches to the right and carries INFO-DY (information dynamics), which carries (R)APL-DT (the reality of application dictates). EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) drops from the main line and carries EXP-CONT(2) (expansion condition, isolated-focus).
